|--------|-------------|
| Temporal lobe | Lateral Fissure (Sulcus); Preoccipital notch |

| Occipital lobe | Parieto-occipital sulcus; Preoccipital notch |
| Frontal lobe | Central Sulcus; Lateral Fissure |
